name: Schematic
lead: A box of blocks: a `.schem` file from the pack, read once by `world.schematic`, or one a script wrote with `world.build`. `min` is the build's own lowest corner, which is the corner `origin` puts down; a file has no coordinates of its own, so its `min` is zero.

functions.name: rotate
functions.description: The build's width, height and length in blocks. The build's own lowest corner, which `origin` puts down; zero for a file. A new build turned clockwise seen from above (90, 180 or 270), states and all.

functions.name: mirror
functions.description: A new build flipped: "x" swaps east and west, "z" north and south.

title: Schematic type
